note: v0.18.0：全面体检修复 —— 界面乱码、复习页横向滚动、诺诺气泡串页、徽章名露出内部编号。① 复习页标题此前显示成 "\u{1F501} Smart review"（转义没被解码）：已修，现在正常显示图标；顺带全站扫了一遍，确认再无同类「原始转义漏到界面」的情况。② 复习页卡片可被左右拖动（超出屏幕 115px）：熊猫练句按钮被拉伸到 298px 撑破容器，已修；现在全站零横向溢出。③ 切换页面时诺诺的气泡不再赖着不走 —— 之前会出现「在看 30 天计划，气泡却在讲字卡」的串页现象。④ 徽章解锁提示此前显示内部编号（streak3, first_city）：现在显示徽章名。⑤ 中文界面补译 149 条（30 天计划标题与说明、18 个城市简介、徽章名、复习动作、对话分类、声调名等）；保留英文的只剩「中文句子的英文释义」与第三方署名，属应当。⑥ 主操作按钮触控高度统一到 44px（场景页打分/更慢、天数切换、查看全部、导出导入）；30 天计划的说明从单行截断改为两行；引导页标题不再断在半字。⑦ 合规修正：香港城市卡标注为「中国香港」。
noteEn: v0.18.0 Audit sweep: raw escape text on screen, horizontal scrolling on Review, Nono bubbles lingering across pages, and internal badge IDs leaking. (1) The Review heading used to render as literal "\u{1F501} Smart review" because the escape was written in static HTML and never decoded. (2) Review cards could be dragged sideways - a 298px-wide stretched button blew past the viewport by 115px; the whole app now has zero horizontal overflow. (3) Nono no longer keeps a previous page's bubble on screen (you could be reading the 30-day plan while the bubble talked about flashcards). (4) Badge unlocks used to show internal IDs such as streak3 / first_city; they now show badge names. (5) 149 Chinese-UI strings added - no more English fallback in the 30-day titles and notes, the 18 city blurbs, badge names, review actions, dialogue categories and tone names. (6) Primary tap targets raised to 44px and the 30-day notes go to two lines instead of truncating mid-sentence. (7) Compliance: the Hong Kong city card is now labelled Hong Kong, China.
